title: Wetboek van vennootschappen en verenigingen / Code des sociétés et des associations: the minutes of a board and of a general meeting
source: Wetboek van vennootschappen en verenigingen of 23 March 2019 (numac 2019A40586), consolidated Dutch text read on Justel 2026-10-09. The French text carries the same article numbers and was not read. Book 5 is the BV/SRL, book 6 the CV/SC, book 7 the NV/SA.

rules.text: The minutes of a collegiate board are signed by the chair and by the directors who ask to sign.

A director with a financial interest that conflicts with the company's tells the other directors; the declaration and the explanation go in the minutes, and in a collegiate board that director takes no part in the deliberation or the vote.
An attendance list is kept at every general meeting.
The minutes of a general meeting are signed by the members of the bureau and by the shareholders who ask to sign.
When shareholders take part online, the minutes mention the technical problems and incidents that kept them from taking part or voting.
The part of the minutes on a conflict of interest goes whole into the annual report or the document filed with the accounts.
